001package org.clafer.ontology;
002
003import gnu.trove.map.TIntObjectMap;
004import gnu.trove.map.TObjectIntMap;
005import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntObjectHashMap;
006import gnu.trove.map.hash.TObjectIntHashMap;
007import java.util.Collection;
008import java.util.Set;
009
010/**
011 *
012 * @author jimmy
013 */
014public class IdMap<T> {
015
016    private final TObjectIntMap<T> idMap = new TObjectIntHashMap<>();
017    private final TIntObjectMap<T> keyMap = new TIntObjectHashMap<>();
018
019    public int getId(T key) {
020        int newId = idMap.size();
021        int id = idMap.adjustOrPutValue(key, 0, newId);
022        if (id == newId) {
023            keyMap.put(id, key);
024        }
025        return id;
026    }
027
028    public int[] getIds(Collection<T> keys) {
029        int[] ids = new int[keys.size()];
030        int i = 0;
031        for (T key : keys) {
032            ids[i++] = getId(key);
033        }
034        return ids;
035    }
036
037    public T getKey(int id) {
038        return keyMap.get(id);
039    }
040
041    public Set<T> keySet() {
042        return idMap.keySet();
043    }
044}
